result.response:
The bug has been fixed and verified.

### Root Cause
When copying an [`XmlMapper`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_c_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/XmlMapper.java), the copy constructor in [`XmlSerializerProvider`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_c_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/ser/XmlSerializerProvider.java#L55-L60) was sharing the original instance's [`XmlRootNameLookup`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_c_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/util/XmlRootNameLookup.java) cache (`_rootNameLookup = src._rootNameLookup;`). Because root element names cached during serialization with the original mapper remained cached in the shared lookup, a copied mapper configured with annotations disabled would reuse the cached annotation-based root element name instead of re-introspecting the type with its own configuration.

### Fix
Updated [`XmlSerializerProvider(XmlSerializerProvider src)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_c_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/ser/XmlSerializerProvider.java#L55-L60) to initialize a new [`XmlRootNameLookup`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_c_fix/src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/dataformat/xml/util/XmlRootNameLookup.java) instance (`_rootNameLookup = new XmlRootNameLookup();`), preventing cache bleed-over across different mapper configurations.

The patch has been saved to [`negative_fix.patch`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/jacksonxml_5_group_c_fix/negative_fix.patch) and all verification tests pass completely.
